comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll on a spring spindle and seat both spindle ends; candidate sifts an industrial media/workpiece mixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Spindle compression, roll loading, and hidden-end socket alignment versus bilateral screen grasp, changing-load stabilization, controlled agitation, and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: New roll mounted, both ends seated, empty tube removed, release and stillness versus recovery/retention thresholds, no spill, dual support, clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Both require bimanual support replacement, but spring-spindle insertion does not exercise selective aperture passage or loose-load control. Missing rubric details: none material.
